metadata.title: CMMC Level 2 practices cited by the Acme Health capstone (subset)
metadata.remarks: Not an official NIST or CMMC-AB publication. NIST's oscal-content repository only publishes SP 800-171 as OSCAL for Rev 3 (renumbered SP_800_171_03.xx.xx IDs); CMMC 2.0 Level 2 is defined against Rev 2, whose ID scheme (e.g. AC.L2-3.1.5) has no official OSCAL catalog. This file contains only the 7 practices this project's component-definition actually implements, authored directly from CMMC's public Level 2 practice descriptions, so control-id values here are internally consistent with the rest of this repo rather than sourced from an upstream catalog that doesn't exist.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Employ the principle of least privilege, including for specific security functions and privileged accounts.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Create and retain system audit logs and records to the extent needed to enable the monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Protect the confidentiality of backup CUI at storage locations.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Monitor, control, and protect communications (i.e., information transmitted or received by organizational systems) at the external boundaries and key internal boundaries of organizational systems.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of CUI during transmission unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of CUI.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Monitor organizational systems, including inbound and outbound communications traffic, to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks.
